name: Agent Smith
lore: A Crossroads operative who trades loud explosions for precise red light. His corner lenses and projected squad make even a narrow alley a dangerous place to stand.

primary.name: Scatterlight
primary.description: Fire seven thin red lasers in a 36-degree cone, 6 damage each. Each ray stops at its first enemy or wall. Maximum 42 damage when every ray hits one target.

secondary.name: Corner Lens
secondary.description: Deploy a floating lens for 5 seconds. Shotgun rays touching it bend toward a nearby enemy within 360 reach at 80% damage. Place it to create new firing angles; walls still stop the rays.

special.name: Ambush
special.description: Aim at an enemy. Three circles behind it flash twice across a 120-degree arc. An agent appears in each, charges for 1 second, then fires a 32-damage beam through enemies and walls. Three beams total; they aim at the target when firing.

passive: Crossfire Protocol: lens-bent shots mark enemies for 3 seconds. Ambush beams deal 5 extra damage to marked enemies.

technique.name: Longshot Scatter
technique.description: Scatterlight reaches 35% farther, with 20% less total damage.

final_technique.name: Tripwire Protocol
final_technique.description: Mark a visible three-target tripwire sequence: 20 per target and 1.5s slow. Replaces Corner Lens, with no reflected shot mechanic.

attack.name: Tripwire Protocol
attack.description: Mark a visible three-target tripwire sequence: 20 per target and 1.5s slow. Replaces Corner Lens, with no reflected shot mechanic.
